milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Oak planks are placed at (-3 to -1, 0-2, 3-5) relative to spawn. Target is the center of the oak_planks structure at (-2,1,4). Max_distance=5 ensures the player must actually navigate south from spawn (distance from origin is ~4.5 blocks, so player must move toward it). Facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the planks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The polished_andesite cave west face (entrance wall) is at x=6 relative to spawn. Target is the cave entrance at (6,2,1). Max_distance=5 requires navigating east from spawn (~6.4 blocks from origin, so player must move toward it).

Uses inventory_has because crafting birch_planks (1 birch_log → 4 birch_planks) results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. Player starts without any birch_planks, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting at the crafting table adjacent to the birch_log.

Uses position_inside_box because the artificial cave is pre-built from polished_andesite and the task_text instructs the player to 'Locate and ENTER the artificial cave.' This is effectively a navigation task — the player must find the 2-high entrance at (6,1-2,1) on the west face and walk inside. The cave interior air space spans (7,1,-1) to (11,3,3) relative to spawn.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Brown stained glass panes are at (3,2,-6) and (3,2,-7) on the trading post west wall. Max_distance=5 requires navigating to the trading post area (~6.7 blocks from spawn origin).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Sea pickle is at (-3,1,-5) in the aquatic area northwest of spawn (~5.8 blocks from origin). Max_distance=5 requires navigating to the prismarine platform.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Blue concrete powder is at (-4,1,-5) in the aquatic area. Max_distance=5 requires proximity. Note: this target is 1 block from sea_pickle but facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player must specifically look toward this block (different direction from sea_pickle when standing between them).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Red bed is at (5,1,-6) inside the trading post. Max_distance=5 requires the player to enter the trading post through the south entrance (~7.9 blocks from spawn origin) and look at the bed.

Uses inventory_has because mining emerald_block with an iron pickaxe drops the block itself as an item (emerald_block drops when mined with iron+ pickaxe in Java 1.20.4 — this is the crafted storage block, NOT emerald_ore which requires Silk Touch). Player starts without emerald_block in inventory.
Uses inventory_has because mining red_nether_brick_wall with a pickaxe drops the wall block itself as an item. Player starts without this item in inventory, so having one confirms successful mining.

Uses inventory_has to detect emerald gained from trading diamonds to the armorer villager (trade: 1 diamond → 1 emerald). Player starts with 0 emeralds. Gaining at least 1 emerald confirms a successful trade. The edge case of crafting emerald_block into emeralds is acknowledged but considered unlikely given the task_text explicitly instructs selling to villagers.

Uses inventory_has to detect that at least 2 emeralds are in inventory, confirming both the Diamond trade (1 emerald) and the Sweet Berries trade (1 emerald) have been completed. The dependency graph enforces sell Diamond before sell Sweet Berries, so min_count=2 correctly distinguishes completion of the second trade from just the first.

task_text: Explore this village area. First, find the oak planks and polished andesite structures. Use the crafting table near the birch log to craft birch planks. Locate and ENTER the artificial cave made of polished andesite to mine the emerald block and red nether brick wall inside. Find the sea pickle and blue concrete powder in the aquatic corner. Locate the brown stained glass pane windows of the trading post, then enter to find the red bed. Finally, sell a Diamond and Sweet Berries to the villagers inside the trading post.
